🛣️ **GOLDRUSH STATIC ROUTE 1 LANDED — `goldrush-static-route-1` as `b3cb110c6` (drained attended 2026-10-09).** Owner 2026-10-09: "Option B - lets fix this once and for all in a proper way" (F-2987-1). Astra on lane-d (`c8b41b00b` + `28417dd2f`, 78,867 tokens, 04:28Z to 04:34Z): `ops/droplet/agenttown.app.nginx.conf` replaces the `/goldrush` 302 fallback with `location = /goldrush { return 301 /goldrush/; }` and `location /goldrush/ { resolver 127.0.0.53 1.1.1.1 valid=300s; set $pages_upstream gold-rush-3in.pages.dev; rewrite ^/goldrush/(.*)$ /$1 break; proxy_pass https://$pages_upstream; proxy_ssl_server_name on; proxy_set_header Host gold-rush-3in.pages.dev; }` (the /api/ block's own pattern; the rewrite because a variable proxy_pass cannot carry a URI); `ops/droplet/verify-goldrush-route.sh` (prerequisites, nginx -t, the canonical paths through 127.0.0.1 with the Host header, an immutable asset, /api/stats; a PASS/FAIL table, no credentials); `docs/ops/agenttown-server.md` gains the five-step owner runbook (stage + nginx -t + reload; verify on the droplet while the Worker route still exists; remove only the Worker route; public verification incl. cf-cache-status; rollback); `scripts/goldrush-route-conf.test.mjs` 5/5. A real `nginx -t` is not available on the Mac and is not claimed: it is the runbook's first gate. Nothing live changed. Evidence 0.8 MB. Landed attended, hash unchanged; the cutover (deploy, droplet write on the owner's word, route deletion, public verification, Cache Rule) is the next act `reviews/goldrush-static-route-1.md`.

Astra on lane-c (`c8ddf96b2` + `4ef388aa6`, 74,799 tokens, 08:30Z to 08:35Z): `scripts/health-watch.sh` and `ops/droplet/edge-watch.sh` gain `api_code`, which requires 200 + an `application/json` content type + a body parsing to `{ok:true, stats:{…}}` (the shape `functions/api/stats.ts` always returns) and otherwise reports `api=200-html`, `api=200-notjson` or `api=2xx-incomplete` as dark with the class in the value (the dashboard's `landing=… game=… api=…` shape kept); `scripts/edge-probe-json.test.mjs` 32 cases, rostered in `test:node-guards`; a bounded live capture of the HTML fallback kept as evidence. Attended fixes on the lane: `scripts/edge-alarm-clock-guard.test.mjs`'s curl stub now answers the API with healthy JSON in every scenario (its arms test landing/game transitions; 9/9), and a control copy of that guard under `artifacts/` renamed `.txt` (the gate-caller audit's orphan, the third time today). Evidence inside the budget. Landed attended, hash unchanged; the Mac probe is live on landing (launchd runs it from the repo); the droplet copy of `edge-watch.sh` is applied with the owner's word (a write on the box) `reviews/api-probe-json-1.md`.

🔺 **F-2642-3 — OWNER: the registry deploy day is now ACTIONABLE, and the desk entry's own trigger condition has been met.** `docs/OWNER-DESK-2026-09-19.md:100–101` reads *"Astra is landing the registry code behind a closed gate now (lane-b) … I bring you the checklist when the code lands."* **The code has landed (`fdfcab4d0`) and the checklist is `docs/ops/account-registry.md`** — five steps, each with its verification and its rollback sentence. ⚖️ **NOTHING DEPLOYED AND NOTHING MIGRATED, by construction and not by promise: the Pages binding ships as a COMMENTED block in `wrangler.toml` with `ACCOUNT_REGISTRY_SCOPE` deliberately unset, so both are absent and the door behaves byte-identically to main — which `closed-gate.test.mjs` asserts directly rather than by inspection.** Routine Pages deploys are unaffected. ⛔ **NO FIRE MAY ENABLE THIS**: the five steps need the owner's own deployment inventory, a quiesce of every identity writer including previews, an independently verified private export, a migration secret and a post-bootstrap smoke test of legacy saves — none of which the repo can know or automate. It is on the desk, not on the board.
